title: Independent re-check of the PLAY-04 opening fixes (R1/R2 repaired; local clock steps)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Re-checked Codex commit da050d5 (CHG-20261016-002/003) against R1/R2 from CHG-20261015-008 and CHG-20261016-001 and the backlog acceptance. Reviewed the fix-only diff from 33e9a7a: reserve returns an unreserved WaitingConcessionEvaluation for waiting concessions; the service runs proof and transition outside locks; commitWaitingConcession rereads under match->clock locks, checks duplicate identity, requires the evaluated state/checkpoint/clock (only lastHealthyUtcMs may advance; heartbeat changes nothing else), refuses reservation, non-running status, backward or expired evaluation, and commits refusals as receipts only and accepted concessions atomically with an ended clock through a narrow permit; the web test now reaches the reservation through the existing Node fixture. Codex's evidence RUN-20261016-002..013 and review note were read; failures are preserved and explained.

RUN-20261016-014..023 at fingerprint 168d05d7. RUN015 service probe (injected UTC): findings 1/2 stay repaired; 20 refused opening concessions add 0 clock revisions/events; during a delayed concession the clock stays running with no reservation and the active choice is accepted, the concession then stale; a heartbeat during evaluation keeps a main-game concession valid; a timeout during evaluation makes it stale with one timeout. RUN016/017 live trials with stock clients: 43 opening steps, 0 busy replies, accepted steps 0.22-0.28 s. RUN018 clean git archive: frozen install and typecheck exit 0 with no app output. RUN019 boundary probe passed. RUN020 77/81 database checks; RUN021 the four failing real-time tests pass unmodified in jump-free windows. RUN022 10/11 Chromium; RUN023 the failing test passes with no jump in it, plus 2 Lab workers.

Environment: the container calendar clock steps back about 1.8-2.5 s roughly every 30 s against monotonic (measured -2,459.5 ms in a 30 s sample), so receipts longer than about 20 s fail the unchanged clock_changed guard and real-time clock tests fail closed (UNAVAILABLE/time_unreliable) when a step lands in them. No clock setting was changed; all such receipts are preserved as failed. Hosted CI on the re-check branch is the qualifying full-suite run.

Verdict: R1 and R2 repaired; no new defect. Observations: a refused opening concession still costs about 0.2 s of engine-worker time (2 workers per process, queue 32, 5 s queue timeout; 8 commands per second per player), a load-gate matter; finding 3, the four policy points and the opening-leave question remain open. Per the Director's CHG-20261016-001 decision, hosted CI on this branch precedes the main fast-forward.

Validation re-check section; ADR0016 note; runbook R1 caution; F-MATCH-CLOCKS description and evidence; FEATURES.md row rewritten for the current state; backlog PLAY-04 status synthetic_acceptance_reaudited_hosted_ci_then_merge; dated re-check line in AGENTS.md/README.md/docs/README.md; handoff rewritten.
